_comment: Obfuscation material for the OPTIONAL installer-embedded Cloudflare proxy key (docs/CLOUDFLARE.md, src/main/embedded-cloudflare-key.ts). This is NOT a secret in the cryptographic sense: it is the passphrase + KDF/cipher parameters that both the build-time encryptor (scripts/embed-cloudflare-key.mjs) and the runtime decryptor read, so it necessarily ships inside the app. Committing it changes nothing about the security posture — a key encrypted with material that also ships is OBFUSCATED, not secret (see the honesty note in embedded-cloudflare-key.ts and the report). It only raises the bar above a plaintext file that `npx asar extract` reads in seconds. The truly-secure option remains the Worker proxy, where the account token never ships at all.
